items.title: 2027 Writing Mentorships and National Translation Mentorship
items.location: Quebec for writing, Canada-wide for translation
items.eligibility: Emerging writers in Quebec, and literary translators working between French and English anywhere in Canada
items.deadlineNote: Writing mentorships close Oct 28 at 5 p.m. ET, translation closes Nov 11 at 5 p.m. ET
items.award: Mentorship ending with a public reading in Montreal
items.summary: Paired mentorships with established writers, and a free-to-apply Mairuth Sarsfield Mentorship for Black, Indigenous and racialized writers.

items.title: 2027 CBC Short Story Prize
items.award: $6,000, a writing residency and publication on CBC Books
items.summary: One of the best-known open contests for Canadian fiction, with long and short lists that bring real attention to new names.

items.title: Open Season Awards
items.summary: Three genres, three winners published in the spring issue. Poetry entries hold up to three poems.

items.title: The Studios at MASS MoCA, July to December 2027
items.award: Residency with financial aid and full fellowships available
items.summary: Residencies beside one of the largest contemporary art museums in North America. Free to apply.

items.title: Wallace Stegner Fellowship, 2027 to 2029
items.eligibility: Poets and fiction writers, no degree required
items.summary: Two years of workshops for poets and fiction writers. A fee waiver request is built into the application.

items.title: 2027 Individual Artist Residencies
items.eligibility: Writers and artists 21 or older, any career stage
items.summary: Private suites near Asheville. Every 2027 residency is filled through this single cycle.

items.title: 2027 Residencies
items.eligibility: New York State writers and artists
items.award: Residency, with sessions for parents and caregivers
items.summary: Poetry and fiction this season, with no application fee. Residencies cannot be deferred.

items.title: Nova Writes Competition
items.eligibility: Emerging Nova Scotian writers 19 or older
items.award: Named prizes in several categories and anthology publication
items.summary: For unpublished work by emerging Nova Scotian writers, including the Budge Wilson Short Story Prize.

items.title: Annual Prose and Poetry Contest 2026 to 2027
items.award: Prizes and publication, entry includes a one-year subscription
items.summary: Up to 3,000 words of prose or three poems per entry, with months to revise before it closes.

items.title: The Welkin Writing Prize
items.summary: A free international prize for pieces up to 100 words, judged on a rolling basis.
